Rome, Italy · Director & CG supervisor

Cristian
Saraullo

I came up on film sets. Then I built the tools I was missing.

Twenty years between camera and pipeline: direction, visual effects and 3D for cinema, television and advertising — and, since 2025, the node-based production platform behind OZENCORE.

The short version

Two jobs, one craft

I work as a CG producer and CG supervisor on features and series — on set when the shot needs someone there, in post for everything that follows. Simulation, compositing, set extension, animation: Houdini, Nuke, Maya, ZBrush, Substance, Resolve.

Most of that work came through Blackstone Studio VFX in Rome, where I spent two years — first as a VFX artist, then as CG line producer. Alongside it, and still today, direction: documentaries, advertising and branded content through doodle S.r.l., the studio I run out of Milan and Rome.

The two halves feed each other. Knowing what a shot costs in post changes how you direct it; having directed changes what you protect when you supervise.

I also teach — 3D modelling and texturing at the Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia, on the Visual Effects Supervisor & Producer course, 2022–2023.

What I do

Four kinds of work

Cinema & VFX

Features and series: CG production, on-set supervision, set extension and invisible effects — the shots nobody is supposed to notice. Twenty-four credits between 2021 and 2024, most of them through Blackstone Studio VFX in Rome.

Advertising

Commercials and branded content for television and brands — Sky, Rai, Fox, Barilla, Magnum, Alitalia, Arena, Bata — written, directed and finished in house at doodle. Short formats, where every second has to earn the next one.

Architectural

Retail environments, stands and spaces rendered before they exist: fifteen years with Grottini Retail, Studio H2G in Detroit, Cubellis in Boston and Fiera Milano, including augmented-reality walkthroughs for clients who needed to walk a store that wasn't built yet.

3D & VFX

The craft underneath all of it: modelling, texturing, simulation, lighting and compositing in Houdini, Nuke, Maya, ZBrush and Substance — and the teaching that comes with it, at the Centro Sperimentale di Cinematografia.

What I build

OZENCORE — AI pipeline

AI video tools were built for speed. I built OZENCORE for control.

Fifty generation engines — image, video, audio — wired into a single node-based pipeline, with the graph logic of Houdini and Nuke and none of their learning curve. It started as the thing I needed on my own productions: a way to run AI shots the way a facility runs any other shot, with versions, recovery and a record of what was made and how.

It now runs on real work — a documentary, a music video, an animated series — and is in private beta at ozencore.com.
